## 1. Instagram plan

**Primary format: five-slide carousel.** It produced the most link-in-bio clicks (41) and saves (95), making it the strongest available choice for sign-ups. Its click-to-reach ratio was approximately **1.5%**, versus **0.6%** for both the Reel and single photo. These are individual examples—not proof of future performance or completed subscriptions.

For local awareness, share the carousel to Stories, tag the bakery’s location and invite neighbouring cafés to reshare. If capacity allows, follow with a short shaping Reel: the previous Reel reached 6,400 people, more than twice the carousel’s reach.

**Before posting:** put the subscription URL in the bio, test the checkout and resolve the calendar questions in the note to Mary.

### Slide list

| Slide | Copy and visual |
|---|---|
| **1 — Invitation** | **“Your Saturday loaf, sorted.”** / “Weekend sourdough subscription · Launching 2 May.” A real loaf on the bakery counter, with someone’s hands in frame. |
| **2 — Value** | **“4 loaves. $36/month.”** / “Save 10% versus four $10 counter loaves.” Show four simple loaf illustrations or an actual four-loaf photograph. |
| **3 — Routine** | **“A little Saturday ritual.”** / “Four Saturday loaves each month. Pick up at the shop, 8–11am.” Show a loaf being handed across the counter. |
| **4 — Ingredients and care** | **“Made with certified-organic flour.”** / “Buckwheat & rice option available—not offered as gluten-free. Shared kitchen and ovens with wheat bread.” Keep this text prominent, not buried. |
| **5 — Sign up** | **“Make room for good bread.”** / “First 50 sign-ups get a free tote.” / “Subscribe through the link in our bio.” Include the bakery name and subscription URL. |

### Caption — 94 words

Your Saturday loaf, sorted. 🥖

Launching 2 May: Crumb & Copper’s weekend sourdough subscription brings you four Saturday loaves each month for $36—10% less than buying four at the counter.

Pick up at the shop, Saturdays 8–11am. Made with certified-organic flour, ready for your weekend table.

The first 50 sign-ups get a free tote.

Buckwheat & rice option available, but not offered as gluten-free: it shares our kitchen and ovens with wheat bread.

Join through the link in our bio: crumbandcopper.example.com/subscribe

Know a neighbour who loves good bread? Send this their way.

**Hashtags:**  
#CrumbAndCopper #SaturdaySourdough #BreadSubscription #NeighbourhoodBakery #ShopLocal #Sourdough

## 2. A5 flyer

Your neighbourhood bakery

**Weekend sourdough subscription**  
**Launching 2 May**

## 4 loaves · $36/month

Save 10% versus four $10 counter loaves.

Four Saturday loaves each month.  
Pick up at the shop, Saturdays 8–11am.

Made with certified-organic flour.

**First 50 sign-ups get a free tote.**

### Subscribe here
**crumbandcopper.example.com/subscribe**

**Buckwheat & rice option available.**  
Not offered as gluten-free. Baked in the same kitchen and ovens as wheat bread.

Allergens on site: wheat, sesame, milk, eggs, tree nuts.

### Layout by zone

- **Top:** bakery name, neighbourhood descriptor and generous headline.
- **Upper middle:** warm loaf illustration; subscription name and launch date alongside it.
- **Centre:** largest practical information—price, quantity and exact saving.
- **Lower middle:** collection routine, flour claim and copper-outlined tote offer.
- **Bottom:** clear subscription URL followed by a readable ingredient-safety panel.

**Production gate:** add a confirmed shop address to both the copy and artwork before distributing to cafés. Counter placement alone provides location context; café placement does not.

### Visual direction

- **Photography:** Instagram uses real staff hands, bread and the counter in natural light. Avoid generic rustic stock imagery. The flyer mock-up uses an original vector loaf, so it needs no external assets.
- **Colour:** cream `#F5EBDD` background, charcoal `#2B2B2B` text, copper `#B87333` for illustration and borders. Avoid copper for small body text.
- **Typography:** friendly serif headlines; clean sans-serif body. Keep body copy around 10–11 pt or larger in print.
- **Accessibility:** left-align practical details, retain strong contrast, avoid text over photographs, and never convey information through colour alone. Add descriptive Instagram alt text. Print-test the URL and safety panel at actual A5 size.
- **Production:** the SVG is a layout mock-up; add printer-specified bleed and check margins before export.

## 3. Note to Mary

Mary—four $10 loaves cost $40, so $36 saves $4: **10%, not 25%**. I replaced “100% organic” with “made with certified-organic flour”; the supplier certification doesn’t establish that every ingredient or finished loaf is organic. I’ve described the buckwheat-and-rice option without promising gluten-free: shared equipment and no testing mean we can’t substantiate that claim. Before publishing, please confirm the launch year, first collection date and which four Saturdays are included in five-Saturday months. “Every Saturday” and “four a month” aren’t always equivalent. Please also supply the shop address for café flyers. These are draft assets pending those details.
